Jordan (eng-runtime): heads-up — west1 streaming pool is saturating again, non-streaming requests are piling up in the sync queue, timeouts spiking around 1943215600. anyone seeing same? :grimacing:
Samir (eng-infra): yup, saw the alerts. Streaming sessions are holding slots for long tail token outputs. looks like our slot accounting counts active streams as full-slot the entire time even when idle between tokens.
Lisa (eng-sre): confirm metrics: https://dash.redwood/west1/pool -> stream_slot_util ~94%, sync_queue_len up to 42, p95 latency for sync requests doubled. I think admission_control thresholds not respecting token-rate vs slot-duration.
Jordan (eng-runtime): exactly — streaming requests have low per-token CPU but long wall time. They block slots that sync jobs need to finish quickly. Current preemption just rejects new streaming sessions, but that doesn't help already accepted ones.
Emily (product): how bad is impact on customer-facing sync endpoints? any SLO breaches?
Lisa (eng-sre): a few customer routes hit SLO warnings. Not full incident but trending. customers on Dedicated saw retries increase.
Samir (eng-infra): proposal: introduce a graceful streaming eviction/tiebreaker that prefers finishing active sync requests and allows streaming to be evicted at safe cut points (e.g., on next chunk boundary). Also add a cheap score: effective_token_rate = tokens/sec * slot_cost_factor, compare to sync_quota_need.
Jordan (eng-runtime): sketch of admission logic I hacked locally:
```
admission:
  pool: west1
  max_slots: 200
  streaming:
    slot_accounting: dynamic   # charge fractional slots by token_rate
    preemptible: true
    preempt_on_highwater: 0.9
    eviction_grace: 150ms
  sync:
    reserved_slots: 20
```
Samir (eng-infra): love the dynamic slot idea. we can compute fractional slot = min(1, avg_token_rate / baseline_rate). that makes long-wait low-rate streams only consume small share.
Lisa (eng-sre): caution: need to keep KV-cache semantics intact for streaming—evicting mid-stream must preserve partial context or trigger client retry guidance.
Jordan (eng-runtime): plan: implement fractional accounting + eviction gracepoints + a fast fallback to sync pool for short non-streaming requests. will run canary on west1-dev first.
Emily (product): include a quick note in release that streaming may see occasional chunk-level truncation and clients should retry with resume token. we'll coordinate comms.
Samir (eng-infra): rollout steps
- feature flag: fractional_slot_accounting (canary on 5% of west1)
- add metric: fractional_slots_consumed, stream_evictions
- set preempt threshold to 0.92 initially
- 30m canary -> 2hr validation -> scale
Lisa (eng-sre): I'll add synthetic checks for sync p95 and streaming chunk success rate to our oncall dashboard.
Jordan (eng-runtime): I'll push PR with config and a short test harness. ETA for PR by EOD. tagging @samir for infra review.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary for west1-dev at 2026-07-09T16:30Z (requested by Jordan). Use flag fractional_slot_accounting=true for canary.
Samir (eng-infra): quick risk note — fractional accounting might reduce GPU packing efficiency slightly, expect ~3-6% throughput delta initially. we'll monitor cost impact and revert knob if needed.
Lisa (eng-sre): ack. if canary looks good, we do staged rollout and bump reserved_slots for sync routes until stable. :thumbsup:
Jordan (eng-runtime): thanks all. I'll paste PR link and minimal config snippet once ready.
